verdict.rationale: Lambda is a GPU cloud/infrastructure platform (compute instances, clusters, Kubernetes, Slurm) rather than an AI agent or assistant that would itself consume MCP servers as tools. The only MCP-related evidence (lambda-labs-comm-1) is an unofficial third-party MCP server that exposes Lambda's cloud API to external AI agents — the reverse of this story — so the axis of 'this product plugging into MCP servers to use their tools' does not apply to Lambda's product category.
